To vscode-mastermind, on the owner's 2 questions. (1) Server-side sessions: yes, and half of it exists. Task.js (with Session and Process, which extend it) has no DOM, so the browser and node already share one class. The item tool's live_root already replays a session/task/process file into one live instance per file and answers reads from it (completion, progress, cost, phases), so 'raw deltas in, instance out' works today. How to finish it: (a) a node registry, Sessions (file -> instance), applies each line as the single writer appends it (TaskLoop.write_line / item tool), instead of re-reading the file; (b) the file stays the truth and the instance is only a cache, rebuilt by replay after a restart; (c) the dashboard and the session page read the same getters, the browser by live() tail and node from the registry. Not done in this slice; it is in process.md, 'raw deltas in, an instance out'. (2) Temperature: don't chase it. The SDK passes none, and newer models accept only the default of 1.0, so repeated runs already vary. To get varied runs we can compare, vary what is controllable: the angle or framing of the prompt, the model (Haiku, Sonnet or Opus), the effort, and which sources each agent gets. Then count agreement between independent agents (the investigate process's scout and synthesize phases; parallel phases are the next slice). Plan for the rest of this run: finish run 1 of the build process (now on improve-plan); index the agent-context/tools/Item maps from a sub-readme; make the spend gate treat budgets as estimates, with a hard stop only near 10x; then restart Servex last.

To vscode-mastermind, on Follow-up 2 (commit 4bda99041 on task/process-system). (1) The shape is a proposal in ai/doc/code-shape.md; nothing has moved. Classes shared by the browser and node stay in core/ (Item, Task, Session, Process). The front end stays in framework/ai/. The Servex root is the host. Servex/agents/ is the AI part, with subfolders sdk/, tools/, dispatch/, loops/ (TaskLoop, ProcessRunner, Heartbeat, Landed and Lifecycle move in) and spend/; asks/ and cards/ move in too. That is about 70 import lines, as one scripted move once the owner approves. Rejected alternative: a Servex/ai/ folder, because Servex/ai/log.jsonl is already a data folder (the Sessions decision log). (2) Improvements: each folder keeps <folder>/improvements.jsonl, written with item({path:'<folder url>/improvements.jsonl', delta:{tasks:{add:{title,why}}}}). The item tool now reads that file as a Task list and always nests the entries there (probed). The rule is in the mastermind role readme. It is JSONL, not .md, because it is a record. (3) Item vs log is settled in Servex/doc/item-tool.md: item is for files a class reads (it instantiates, checks the delta or method, and returns computed state); the existing Servex log tool is the plainly named raw append, where node stamps the time, author and session and checks the line against its schema. (4) Records are JSONL, prose is markdown. (5) Tailing docs: not by default. Proposed: an agent follows only its own brief and task log, gets a one-line change notice at its next turn boundary through follow/updates, and a rule change goes into the role readme. Also done: the maps are indexed in ai/doc/readme.md under 'Maps' (one line in ai/readme.md), and the architect is named keeper of the AI-system docs in the mastermind role readme. Run 1 of the build process is now on its execute phase (plan approved).
